name: list_files
label: List files
summary: List the selected folders and their contents.

name: read_file
label: Read file
summary: Read a file or a line range.

name: shell_run
label: Shell
summary: Run Bash, rg, ast-grep, git and Python in an isolated sandbox.

name: code_search
label: Code search
summary: Find functions by name with their bodies and calls.

name: code_graph
label: Code graph
summary: Search symbols and follow callers and callees. Offered when a selected code project has a generated graph.

name: search_documents
label: Search documents
summary: Search the knowledge base for citable excerpts.

name: report_not_covered
label: Report not covered
summary: Mark a question the documents do not answer.

name: ssh_run
label: SSH
summary: Run a command on a selected server.

name: get_resource
label: Resource info
summary: What is recorded about a server, service, environment or code project.

name: get_document
label: Read document
summary: Read a document given to this run or linked to a resource given to it.

name: propose_service
label: Propose service
summary: Propose a service for review (runs started from a server that turn it on).

name: propose_document
label: Propose document
summary: Propose a document for review (runs started from a server, service or environment that turn it on).

name: save_document
label: Save a document
summary: Save this run's draft of a document it may edit.

name: edit_document
label: Edit a document
summary: Replace one passage in this run's draft of a document.

name: run_subagent
label: Start subagents
summary: Hand a separate part of the work to a helper that runs in parallel.
